decision_summary.court: High Court of Judicature at Madras

issue_disposition.finding: Hostel premises used for residential occupation cannot automatically be treated as commercial merely because the owner conducts a hostel business.
The writ petitions were maintainable despite the statutory appeal because questions of law and natural justice arose.
Demand notices issued without prior notice or opportunity violated principles of natural justice.

operative_directions: Impugned commercial tariff demand notices were quashed.
Authorities shall treat eligible hostel premises under residential classification where facts are comparable.
Authorities remain free to verify actual usage wherever necessary.
Future assessments must comply with principles of natural justice.

thinkingos_summary.communication: Living in a building is more important than how the owner earns income from it.
